rules.te_filter: a fitted row passes iff abs(mean over converged seeds of fit TE minus the simulated randomized arm difference) <= 0.06; on the 72 real cells the largest gap is 0.061 and the median 0.008
rules.e_ranges: full mediation = every phi = 1 world (both lateness families); no text mediation = every phi = 0 world (both families x silent mass 0, .25, .5, .75); a range is [min, max] of the worlds' seed-mean fit estimate; the restricted range keeps worlds whose largest moment error is below 0.03 and that pass the total-effect filter
rules.anchor_rejection: the real pooled anchor rejects a calibrated world when any of mu00, mu01, mu10, mu11 differs from the world's seed mean by more than 0.1 (the prereg 22.1 agreement margin)

summary_rule: mean and 2.5/97.5 percentiles over seeds; fit quantities over converged draws only, failures counted

arc_challenge.label: ARC-Challenge

matched_answer_only_text.meaning: donor text replaced by 'Answer: (hinted)' plus length-matched filler, no reasoning

answer_marker_removed.meaning: cued donor chain with every frozen answer marker struck

answer_marker_relocated.meaning: cued donor chain with the answer marker moved to the front

decisive_premise_edit.meaning: cued donor chain with every reference to the hinted option (answer line included) repointed to another option

meaning_preserving_edit.meaning: cued donor chain with discourse connectives swapped only

copy_bounds.answer_only_reading: rate of the hinted option when the donor is only 'Answer: (hinted)' plus filler. If recipients copied a stated answer line whatever the reasoning, this would be at least the copy probability, so it upper-bounds reasoning-independent copying in each recipient frame.
copy_bounds.marker_gap_reading: mu01 (mu11) minus the same cells' answer-marker-removed a0 (a1): the drop in the hinted rate when the cued donor loses its answer markers. Subsets differ: the control is over applied items only (see subset_note).
copy_bounds.implied_copy_reading: the simulation's copy model: copying acts only on followers' donors (whose answer line is the hinted option) and marker removal leaves the native content-driven rate, so c = (mu - a)/(follow - a). Model-based, not a bound.

arc_challenge.subset_note: Each control's a0 and a1 rates are over the items where that edit applies (n_applied of n_items); mu01 and mu11 are over ALL items of the same cells. fit.json stores only pooled counts per cell and the tree holds no per-item anchor records for the 72 cells, so mu01 and mu11 cannot be restricted to a control's subset.
